title: Delights of Singapore and Malaysia with Sentosa Island
highlights: From Singapore's dazzling metropolis to Malaysia's lush rainforests, make unforgettable memories on this Southeast Asian adventure of Singapore and Malaysia.
Embark on a thrilling nighttime adventure, encountering over 1,000 nocturnal animals in their natural habitat on a guided tram tour.
Enjoy panoramic views of Sentosa Island from a cable car and get up close to your favourite celebrities at Madame Tussauds.
Visit the iconic Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur and enjoy breathtaking city views from the Skybridge.
Soar above the lush rainforest canopy on a thrilling cable car ride to Genting Highlands, followed by a visit to Batu Caves, home to the iconic 140-foot golden statue of Lord Murugan.
overview:
About the Tour:
Immerse yourself in the captivating blend of modernity and tradition as you explore Singapore and Malaysia. This dynamic vacation offers a deep dive into the cultural and artistic evolution of two of Southeast Asia’s most beloved destinations.
Experience the awe-inspiring manmade marvels of Singapore, such as the iconic Gardens by the Bay and the thrilling Universal Studios. Then, venture into Malaysia’s tropical wonders, including the serene Genting Highlands and the majestic Batu Caves. This tour promises an unforgettable journey, sparking your curiosity to delve deeper into the magic of this diverse region.

know_before_you_go: International/ domestic flights are not included in the package price.
Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
No bill will be reimbursed against any missed service/facility.
The dates for the activities cannot be changed as the number of visitors at some places are limited. The traveller have to pay an additional cost for the activities incase of rescheduling.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
Please note that it is mandatory to purchase travel insurance while visiting Singapore. Travel insurance is not a part of the package.
In the event of cancellation, the included activities and tickets are non-refundable.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Eating and drinking on public transport is not allowed.
Singapore’s climate is commonly tropical and humid. It is advisable to carry light, comfortable clothes.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
While credit card payments are widely accepted in Singapore, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Singapore! Upon arrival at the Singapore Changi Airport, you'll be transferred to the hotel where you will check in. Take some rest and later explore the city at your own pace. You're in for a treat as there are so many things to do here. You can watch LIVE animal shows at the Singapore Zoo. Take a walk on Bukit Batok Hill, relax at Changi Beach Park, or shop at Orchard Road. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Singapore Half Day City Tour | Night Safari Zoo Visit
days.desc: Get ready for a transfer to discover iconic landmarks of Singapore like the Art Science Museum, Helix Bridge, Marina Bay, Merlion statue and Istana. Later, get transferred to the Night Safari Zoo, world's first nocturnal zoo and explore 7 geographical zones, witness Malayan Tapir, Bornean Bearded Pig and massive pythons during the night show. Also, hop on a tram for a closer view of nocturnal animals in the park. Conclude the day with a transfer back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Sentosa Island | Madame Tussauds Visit
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer for a day trip to Sentosa Island. Begin with a cable car ride from the Mount Faber Station, straight to the island. Once you reach, visit Madame Tussauds, where you can take a selfie with the wax figures of your favourite celebrities, or walk the red carpet. You can also fight alongside Marvel Super Heroes in their Marvel Universe 4D cinema. After a fulfilling day, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer from Singapore to Kuala Lumpur | Leisure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to the Singapore Changi Airport for a flight to Kuala Lumpur. At the airport, turn your waiting time into a fun-filled experience with attractions like a jacuzzi, swimming pool, and an aerobridge. Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to the hotel, check in and relax for a while. Later, explore the city's highlights like KL Bird Park, Petaling Street, etc at your own pace. In the evening, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
days.desc: Today, begin the day with a transfer for a city tour of Kuala Lumpur. Explore iconic attractions like the Petronas Twin Towers and unique street markets around. Visit the Sultan Abdul Samad Building and Kuala Lumpur City Gallery. Continue to Tugu Negara, pay your respects to the heroes, and don't forget to take home some delicious chocolates from the Cocoa Boutique (at an extra cost). In the evening, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Get transferred for a journey to Genting Highlands. Ascend to the top via cable car from (station name), enjoying the scenic beauty en route. Upon arrival, visit the amusement parks, bars, restaurants and shops catering to all age groups. Don't miss out on challenging your luck at the Genting Casino! On your way back to Kuala Lumpur, climb 272 steps to Batu Caves and admire the 140-foot-tall statue of Lord Murugan. Finally, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
